essence: The hiccough region is measured from the navel to its defined end at the vasu corner.
The seven-angula measure is the known cause of the art.
The crest width is desired according to sky-measure.
The hole is in the middle of the chest staff, measured by the Viṣṇu-part star.
The hip staff has a declared width of seven angulas.
